title: MaleTheme Duo #022 · 남 머슬 모델·피치 듀이·천사 테마·메탈릭 / 남 피트니스 모델·코퍼 브론즈·경찰관 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind them, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Argentinian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, smooth light-olive skin, a bright open smile showing his teeth, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a tin small flared temple bell, an iron hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single platinum ring. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal mirror-polished metallic white satin with mirror-polished metallic gold trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black work boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Brazilian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, smooth warm bronze skin, a warm natural smile, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper ship's anchor, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, a gold small flared temple bell, a tin cube-shaped block, a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a silver miniature anvil, a copper hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered silver anklets. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge, a thin black leather chest harness carrying a silver badge, steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, and a minimal black leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black sculptural heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
